description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter class and related classes for rendering a complex, multi-section home screen in an Android application. It manages various view types including header, banner, and content rows, with detailed focus and navigation handling for accessibility and user interaction.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for managing multiple section types (header, banner, content rows) in a vertical RecyclerView on the home screen.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter.HeaderSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the header section, including brand text and top navigation bar with focus behavior management.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter.BannerSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the banner section, containing a horizontal RecyclerView for banners with snapping and focus handling.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter.ContentRowSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for content rows, each containing a title and horizontal list of cards, with focus and scroll handling.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates different layouts and initializes ViewHolders based on view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the appropriate ViewHolder for each section type.

methods.name: HeaderSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Sets up the header views, styles, and focus behavior for the navigation bar.

methods.name: BannerSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Configures the banner RecyclerView, including size calculations, padding, snap helper, and focus management.

methods.name: ContentRowSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Sets up individual content row title and inner RecyclerView of cards, managing focus and scrolling.
